dashboard.label: Break-Glass Account (secadm)
dashboard.description: Centralised view of every change made to, and every use of, the break-glass account(s) listed in adx_breakglass_accounts.csv, built from Windows Security events collected on the domain controllers (4624/4625, 4723/4724, 4738, 4722/4725, 4740/4767, 4728/4732/4756, 5136, 4672, 4648, 4768/4769/4771). Any non-zero red tile is an event worth correlating with an incident ticket.
